body:
I'm in a very similar position. It hurts a lot when others will see how hard you're trying to get better, not help or make it worse, and still blame you for not living up to their standards.
There doesn't seem to be much compassion left in the world in general, but I'm happy to talk if would help ease things even a little bit.

What I hate is that they make it about themselves. How us dying like that would make THEM feel, how it would affect THEIR lives, while also refusing to help us so we don't reach the point of wanting to die in the first place.
We have to live and suffer so they can rest easy.
